real_problems.goal: Complete successful search must reflect intact originals, not just a past index build
real_problems.finding: Watermark alone cannot detect post-build canonical BLOB corruption
real_problems.scenario: Build generation, damage retained original, search old posting gives OK without current integrity check
real_problems.resolution: Reverify bounded full generation and recompute canonical + postings fingerprint under snapshots on every query

real_problems.goal: Bounded schema-verified disposable cache and atomic generation
real_problems.finding: Exact cache schema, size/work limits and publication/rollback rules not selected
real_problems.scenario: Partial rebuild advances watermark or unlimited term/corpus work exhausts resources
real_problems.impact: Incomplete index appears complete or resource work is unbounded
real_problems.resolution: Own exact cache schema/headers, explicit limits, single atomic replacement; any fault preserves old generation/no new watermark

real_problems.goal: Reuse actual canonical importer/read components without format changes
real_problems.finding: Historical search prose calls canonical DB bank.sqlite3, actual Store pins bank.sqlite
real_problems.scenario: New adapter hardcodes historical prose name and misses the accepted DB
real_problems.impact: False Bank unavailable or wrong new initialization
real_problems.resolution: Reuse existing Store and its fixed bank.sqlite; only separate cache basename follows search-cache.sqlite3

questions.question: How to keep complete-search integrity meaningful after index build within bounded work?
questions.proposal: Review targeted canonical integrity and cache generation binding, including post-build BLOB corruption. Select an explicit fail-closed per-query/work-unit budget; do not treat stale cache as evidence that originals remain intact. If an alternative changes scope/complexity substantially, record and seek that decision.

questions.question: How to bound generation rebuild and atomic publication without canonical schema changes?
questions.proposal: Separate cache-owned versioned generation staging/postings; iterate bounded canonical units and publish only after complete accounted corpus. Keep old generation/error semantics visible. Canonical filename is existing Store bank.sqlite, not the historical prose label bank.sqlite3.

limitations: Implementation and actual Windows proof still pending
Trusted code/operator/current owner/private roots and root parents
Prototype performance is not promised for a full real Bank
